title: H125 / AS350 B3e Quick Reference
intro: For training use only. This is an informal quick reference of selected H125 / AS350 B3e RFM limitations and operating numbers. Always use the official RFM / QRH as primary reference.

items.label: VNE power on / power off (Hp = 0)
lines: VNE power on: 155 kt IAS at Hp = 0, less 3 kt per 1000 ft.
VNE power off: 125 kt IAS at Hp = 0, less 3 kt per 1000 ft.

items.label: Cold weather corrections
lines: OAT < -30 °C: reduce VNE power on by 10 kt.
OAT < -20 °C: reduce VNE power off by 20 kt (minimum 65 kt).

items.label: Altitude limits
lines: Maximum operating altitude in flight: Hp = 23 000 ft (7010 m).

items.label: Temperature limits
lines: Minimum temperature: -40 °C.
Maximum temperature: ISA+35 °C, limited to +50 °C.

items.label: Normal and caution ranges
lines: Normal operating range: 375–405 rpm.
Caution ranges: 320–375 rpm and 405–430 rpm.

items.label: Power-off limits
lines: Minimum power-off NR: 320 rpm.
Maximum power-off NR: 430 rpm.

items.label: Rotor brake
lines: Prohibited before engine shutdown; maximum brake application speed: 170 rpm.
Minimum time between two consecutive brake applications: 5 min.

items.label: Aural warnings
lines: Low NR aural warning: ≤ 360 rpm.
High NR aural warning: ≥ 410 rpm.

items.label: N1 (gas generator)
lines: Minimum stabilized speed: 67 %.
Maximum continuous rating: ΔN1 = -4 %.
Takeoff power range: ΔN1 = -4 % to 0 %; maximum takeoff rating: ΔN1 = 0 %.
Maximum transient: ΔN1 = +1 % (≤ 20 s).

items.label: N2 (power turbine)
lines: Minimum: 367 rpm; normal operating range: 367–413 rpm.
Maximum continuous: 413 rpm.
Maximum transient: 440 rpm (20 s).
NR 386 rpm corresponds to N2 39 158 rpm.

items.label: Starting limits
lines: Maximum continuous during start: 750 °C.
Maximum transient during start: 840 °C (10 s).

items.label: Flight limits
lines: Maximum continuous rating: 905 °C.
Takeoff power range: 905–949 °C; maximum takeoff rating: 949 °C.
Maximum transient: 981 °C (20 s).

items.label: Main transmission torque
lines: Maximum continuous rating: 92.7 %.
Takeoff power range: 92.7–100 %; maximum takeoff rating: 100 %.
Maximum transient: 104 % (5 s).
100 % torque corresponds to 535 kW at NR 386 rpm.

items.label: First Limitation Indicator (FLI)
lines: Maximum continuous rating: 9.6; takeoff power: 9.6–10; maximum takeoff rating: 10.
Maximum transient: 10.4 (5 s).

items.label: Takeoff power usage
lines: Maximum airspeed with takeoff power: 40 KIAS.
If N1 and/or TOT is in the takeoff power range (value underlined in yellow): 5 min continuous (pre-OP-4309) or 30 min continuous (post-OP-4309).
If only torque is in the takeoff power range: no time limit.
Heating and demisting are authorised up to maximum takeoff power.

items.label: Internal weight limits
lines: Maximum internal weight for flight, takeoff and landing: 2250 kg (4961 lb).
Minimum internal weight for flight, takeoff and landing: 1310 kg (2888 lb).

items.label: Increased internal gross weight (SUP.28: high landing gear and dual hydraulics)
lines: Maximum internal weight in flight: 2370 kg (5225 lb).
Maximum internal weight for IGE takeoff and landing: 2370 kg (5225 lb).

items.label: Baggage compartments
lines: RH cargo compartment: max 100 kg (220 lb) at max 300 kg/m² (62.5 lb/ft²).
LH cargo compartment: max 120 kg (264 lb) at max 300 kg/m² (62.5 lb/ft²).
Rear cargo compartment: max 80 kg (176 lb) at max 145 kg/m² (30 lb/ft²).

items.label: Cabin floor (max distributed load 300 kg/m² / 62.5 lb/ft²)
lines: Rear cabin floor: max 310 kg (682 lb).
Forward left cabin floor: max 150 kg (330 lb).

items.label: Landing / rotor stop slopes
lines: Maximum slope for landing / rotor stopping: nose up 10°, nose down 6°, sideways 8°.

items.label: Running landings & maneuvering
lines: Excluding emergencies and failures, maximum speed for running landings: 40 kt (74 km/h).
Continuous operation in servo-transparency (load feedback felt in the controls) is prohibited.
Single hydraulics, post MOD 07-20039: the LIMIT light and audio tone indicate proximity to servo-transparency but must not be relied on as the sole means to avoid it.

items.label: Fuel
lines: Normal fuels (no restriction): Jet A-1, Jet A, JP-8, JP-5 (full list in RFM Section 2.5).
Wide-cut Jet B / JP-4 is a replacement fuel with a restricted envelope: OAT ≤ 25 °C and Hp ≤ 5000 ft (1524 m).
Russian TS-1 / RT kerosene is a replacement fuel with a restricted envelope: OAT ≤ 40 °C and Hp ≤ 15 000 ft (4572 m).

items.label: Engine oil
lines: Maximum oil temperature: 117 °C (caution range shown on the gauge).
Minimum oil temperature before power application: 0 °C (oil 5 cSt) or -10 °C (oil 3 to 3.9 cSt); warm up with the collective in full low pitch, twist grip in IDLE or FLIGHT.
Oil pressure limits are variable and depend on N1 (see the RFM figure).

items.label: Electrical
lines: Maximum voltage: 31.5 V (rated 26–29 V).
Maximum continuous current: 150 A (200 A if the optional 200 A starter generator is installed, SUP.29).
Pre-start check: battery voltage > 22 V.

items.label: Approved operations
lines: Approved for day and night VFR.
Additional equipment may be required by operational regulations.

items.label: Crew & occupancy
lines: Minimum flight crew: 1 pilot in the right seat.
Maximum number of occupants (including crew): 6.

items.label: Prohibited operations (selected)
lines: Aerobatic manoeuvres.
Engine starting when snow or ice accumulations are in or around the engine air intake.
Flight in falling snow without optional sand filter installed.
Flight in freezing rain or icing conditions.
In-flight engine power reduction using the twist grip control (except where explicitly allowed for training / emergency procedures in the RFM).
Intentional complete VEMD cut-off in flight (lane 1 + 2).
